name: Vaisakh Y P
tagline: I capture moments, details and stories through a frame.
bio: I’m Vaisakh Y P, a photographer and visual storyteller based in Kerala, India.
Through FramesandVisualsbyYsh, I explore wildlife, nature, macro photography, travel and the small details that often go unnoticed.
My approach is simple — slow down, observe, and capture the moment as it truly feels.
